facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 79°F at pass elevation.

facts.text: Snow left Big Red Mountain (6,060 ft) and Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft) 27 to 39 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Big Red Mountain
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), May 28 (2024), June 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 18 (2023), April 23 (2024), April 30 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Big Red Mountain (6,060 ft) and Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft).

evidence.name: Big Red Mountain
evidence.detail: 1.6 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 35.9 in (2023), 21.8 in (2024), 31.9 in (2025)

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: 1.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 32.7 in (2023), 15.0 in (2024), 27.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 25 and April 6, carried from the melt-out date at Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 1,872 ft above the pass; points to January 25 to April 6
